title: Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.21223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c_x,c_y,w,h,\theta)$ and $(c_x,c_y,h,w,\theta+\pi/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alon

translated_title: 面向半监督航拍目标检测的 Oriented Semi-DETR（旋转框半监督DETR）
translated_abstract: 半监督目标检测最近被扩展到了DETR框架，而旋转框在此引入了轴对齐框所不存在的歧义问题：从参数到矩形的映射是二对一的，因为 $(c_x,c_y,w,h,\theta)$ 和 $(c_x,c_y,h,w,\theta+\pi/2)$ 表示的是同一个旋转矩形。损失和匹配代价均基于参数计算，因此在空间上完全重合的两个框，在驱动训练的度量上可能相距甚远。由此，一个定位正确的学生预测框会被回归损失错误惩罚，而膨胀的匹配代价会导致高斯混合模型（GMM）过滤器将其丢弃。我们提出 Oriented Semi-DETR，在伪框进入训练的各个环节中消除这种歧义。交换对齐目标选择向更接近学生预测的编码进行回归；交换不变可靠性代价在匹配代价内部对两种编码取最小值，使过滤器仅依据几何形状做出决策……
tldr: 该论文提出 Oriented Semi-DETR，通过交换对齐的目标选择和交换不变的可靠性代价，消除了半监督旋转框检测中参数二对一映射带来的歧义，避免定位正确的学生预测被错误惩罚或被GMM过滤器丢弃。
en_tdlr: Oriented Semi-DETR resolves the two-to-one parameterization ambiguity of oriented boxes in semi-supervised DETR through Swap-aligned Target Selection and a Swap-invariant Reliability Cost, preventing correctly localized student predictions from being wrongly penalized or discarded by the GMM filter.
